title: TradeSieve canonical application contract registry
description: Generated canonical registry for implemented and planned adapters. Schema registration alone creates no endpoint, tool, or raw export. Consumers select a named schema from $defs; do not edit this artifact.

BusinessAction.description: Operational instruction that the calling workflow must enforce.
BusinessAction.title: BusinessAction

ClassificationCandidate.description: Proposed classification only; never an automatic legal determination.

candidate_only.description: Always true: the code remains a candidate until an authorized human classification decision is recorded.
candidate_only.title: Candidate Only

ClassificationCandidate.title: ClassificationCandidate

FiniteParserId.description: Closed Phase 1 parser inventory; callers cannot select executable code.
FiniteParserId.title: FiniteParserId

HashedVersionReference.description: Exact immutable SemVer identity used by deterministic policy evaluation.
HashedVersionReference.title: HashedVersionReference

resolved_finding_ids.description: Findings resolved by this disposition. It may be empty for HUMAN_BLOCKED or CLOSED_NO_ACTION; application policy requires HUMAN_CLEARED to resolve every open P0/P1 finding.
resolved_finding_ids.title: Resolved Finding Ids

evidence_refs.description: Evidence considered for the disposition. Application policy enforces sufficient evidence for HUMAN_CLEARED and configured block policy.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

expires_at.description: Required and non-null for HUMAN_CLEARED; application policy validates that condition.
expires_at.title: Expires At

resolved_finding_ids.description: Findings resolved by this disposition. It may be empty for HUMAN_BLOCKED or CLOSED_NO_ACTION; application policy requires HUMAN_CLEARED to resolve every open P0/P1 finding.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence considered for the disposition. Application policy enforces sufficient evidence for HUMAN_CLEARED and configured block policy.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

expires_at.description: Required and non-null for HUMAN_CLEARED; application policy validates that condition.
expires_at.title: Expires At

RuleEvaluationOutcome.description: Fact-presence result only; no value grants legal permission.
RuleEvaluationOutcome.title: RuleEvaluationOutcome

RuleEvaluationRecord.description: Deterministic rule trace; FACTS_PRESENT is not clearance or permission.
RuleEvaluationRecord.title: RuleEvaluationRecord

tenant_id.description: Application tenant scope. REST derives the authoritative value from the authenticated principal and rejects a body mismatch.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

correlation_id.description: Application trace identifier. When X-Correlation-ID is present, REST treats it as authoritative and rejects a body mismatch.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

ScreeningResult.description: Decision-support result; transport/HTTP success never means clearance.
ScreeningResult.title: ScreeningResult

Signal.description: Presentation signal; GREEN_CANDIDATE is never legal clearance.
Signal.title: Signal
